fiche: Une larve de charbon tiède qui rampe dans les cendres des volcans et grignote les braises oubliées.
apparence: Segmented crawling grub made of charcoal plates with glowing cracks; colors: charcoal black, ember orange, ash grey.

stades.bebe: A round charcoal pebble-grub with two big glowing orange eyes and a tiny ember spark on its back.
stades.enfant: The body stretches into three charcoal segments and grows six stubby ash legs.
stades.ado: Glowing orange cracks spread along longer segments and a small flame crest appears on the head.
stades.adulte: A long armored charcoal crawler whose back plates open like a brazier, releasing a row of steady flames.
stades.ancien: Its plates turn ash-white with deep glowing fissures, a crown of smoldering embers and a trail of smoke like a long beard.

fiche: Une petite boule de neige à pattes dont les piquants de glace poussent pendant les nuits de blizzard.
apparence: Small round quadruped covered in snow fluff and icicle spines; colors: snow white, pale ice blue, frost silver.

stades.bebe: A fluffy snowball with big dark eyes, a tiny blue nose and no visible legs.
stades.enfant: Four short paws appear and small soft frost spikes sprout on its back.
stades.ado: The spikes grow into clear icicles and a frosty tail with a crystal tip appears.
stades.adulte: A sturdy snow beast with a back covered in long sharp ice spines that fan out like a shield.
stades.ancien: Its fluff becomes a thick frosted mane, its spines turn opaque and cracked, and a small ring of floating snowflakes circles its head.

fiche: Une goutte d'eau vivante qui saute de flaque en flaque et adore les sources pétillantes.
apparence: Translucent water droplet body with bubbles floating inside; colors: clear aqua, deep blue, white foam.

stades.bebe: A single round water droplet with two big shiny eyes and one bubble inside.
stades.enfant: Two little splashing arm-like ripples form on its sides and a curl of water rises on top.
stades.ado: The body becomes a taller wobbly blob with a foam collar and several swirling bubbles inside.
stades.adulte: A large living wave-shaped mass with foam-capped crest and strong water tendrils for arms.
stades.ancien: Its water turns calm and deep blue, with pebbles and tiny shells drifting inside like relics and a long foam beard.

fiche: Une étincelle curieuse qui flotte dans les nuages d'orage et grésille quand elle est contente.
apparence: Floating spark orb with crackling zigzag appendages; colors: electric yellow, white, violet.

stades.bebe: A tiny glowing yellow orb with two wide eyes and a single crackling spark on top.
stades.enfant: Two small zigzag lightning arms appear and a violet static halo surrounds it.
stades.ado: The orb gains a thin crackling tail and three jagged spikes on its head.
stades.adulte: A bright floating core inside a cage of four orbiting lightning bolts, with sharp zigzag arms.
stades.ancien: Its core dims to a deep violet with branching white crackle-cracks and a slow ring of orbiting sparks like a halo.

fiche: Un petit caillou têtu qui se met debout au bord des sentiers de montagne pour regarder passer les voyageurs.
apparence: Stacked rock body with pebble limbs and moss patches; colors: slate grey, sandy brown, moss green.

stades.bebe: A round grey pebble with big eyes and two tiny pebble feet.
stades.enfant: Two small pebble arms appear and a flat stone forms a little hat on its head.
stades.ado: The body stacks into two boulders with chunky stone fists and a pointed rocky crest.
stades.adulte: A sturdy stone golem of stacked boulders with huge slab fists and stone plate shoulders.
stades.ancien: Its stones are cracked and covered in thick moss and lichen, with a long stalactite beard and a stone walking cane.

fiche: Un petit oiseau de courant d'air qui siffle en virevoltant au-dessus des prairies venteuses.
apparence: Small bird made of swirling air ribbons and feather-like gusts; colors: pale mint, white, sky blue.

stades.bebe: A round puff of white air with big eyes, a tiny beak and a single swirl on its belly.
stades.enfant: Two small ribbon wings appear and a spiral tuft of wind curls on its head.
stades.ado: The body slims, the wings lengthen into flowing air streamers and a forked gust tail forms.
stades.adulte: A swift bird whose wings are sharp layered wind blades and whose tail is a spinning mini whirlwind.
stades.ancien: Its feathers become long pale silver wisps like a flowing beard and mantle, with a slow ring of leaves orbiting it.

fiche: Un serpent de fumée et de flammes qui se glisse entre les fissures brûlantes des volcans.
apparence: Serpent body of dark smoke wrapped around a flaming core; colors: smoke grey, flame orange, deep red.

stades.bebe: A small round puff of grey smoke with a glowing orange heart and two big bright eyes.
stades.enfant: The puff stretches into a short smoky worm with a flickering flame tip on its tail.
stades.ado: Its body lengthens, red scales of embers appear along the spine and a flame frill grows behind the head.
stades.adulte: A long coiling serpent of thick smoke with a blazing frill hood and a burning tail whip.
stades.ancien: Its smoke turns pale ash with drifting cinders, its frill becomes a crown of slow dark flames and long smoky whiskers hang from its jaw.

fiche: Un cheval d'écume qui galope sur les vagues des lagons et disparaît dans les embruns.
apparence: Horse-like quadruped of flowing water with a foam mane and coral hooves; colors: turquoise, white foam, deep sea blue.

stades.bebe: A round water foal with stubby legs, big eyes and a tiny foam tuft on its head.
stades.enfant: Its legs lengthen with small coral hooves and a short foam mane appears.
stades.ado: The body becomes slender and translucent with fish-fin ears and a wavy water tail.
stades.adulte: A powerful water stallion with a crashing wave mane, coral hooves and fin-like crests on its legs.
stades.ancien: Its mane becomes a long white foam beard, shells and barnacles cover its hooves and a soft ring of droplets floats above its head.

fiche: Une longue chenille de galets qui creuse lentement des tunnels sous les canyons.
apparence: Segmented centipede-like body of round stones linked by clay, with many stony legs; colors: river-stone grey, ochre, rust brown.

stades.bebe: A single round smooth pebble with big eyes and four tiny stone legs.
stades.enfant: A second pebble segment attaches behind it with four more legs and small stone mandibles.
stades.ado: It grows into a chain of five stone segments with sharper legs and a flat rock shield on the head.
stades.adulte: A long armored boulder centipede with dozens of pointed stone legs and a heavy drill-shaped rock head.
stades.ancien: Its stones are worn smooth and veined with quartz, covered in moss and fossils, with long stalactite antennae.

fiche: Une gardienne des glaciers qui sculpte des tempêtes de neige avec ses longues mains de givre.
apparence: Tall bipedal figure with a body of packed snow and a cloak of icicles; colors: glacier blue, white, frost violet.

stades.bebe: A small round snow mound with big eyes and a tiny icicle sprouting on top like a hair tuft.
stades.enfant: Two short legs and mitten-like snowy arms appear, plus a hood of frost.
stades.ado: The body grows tall and thin, fingers become long icicles and a short cape of ice shards forms.
stades.adulte: A tall snow guardian with a flowing cloak of hanging icicles, long ice-blade fingers and a crystal crown.
stades.ancien: Her snow body is cracked like old glacier ice, with a long frozen beard of icicles, a frost cane and an aurora halo.

fiche: Un bœuf d'orage qui charge à travers les plaines quand le tonnerre gronde et fait tomber la foudre avec ses cornes.
apparence: Bulky bovine quadruped with storm-cloud fur and lightning-shaped horns; colors: storm grey, electric yellow, cobalt blue.

stades.bebe: A round grey cloud-calf with stubby legs, huge eyes and two tiny spark nubs on its head.
stades.enfant: Short zigzag horns grow and small yellow spark stripes appear on its fluffy cloud coat.
stades.ado: Its shoulders bulk up, horns branch like lightning bolts and a crackling tail tuft forms.
stades.adulte: A massive storm bull with a dark thundercloud hump, huge branching lightning horns and glowing hooves.
stades.ancien: Its cloud fur turns white like old rain clouds, its horns are scarred and crackling, with a long stormy beard and a ring of rumbling clouds.

fiche: Un voyageur des hautes altitudes qui vit au cœur des tornades et les guide à travers le ciel.
apparence: Floating funnel-shaped body of spinning wind with a calm eye at its center; colors: storm teal, white, pale grey.

stades.bebe: A small spinning swirl of air with one big calm eye in the middle and two tiny gust puffs.
stades.enfant: The swirl becomes a little funnel and two ribbon arms of wind curl from its sides.
stades.ado: The funnel grows taller with a wide spinning cap and debris like leaves orbits around it.
stades.adulte: A towering tornado being with a crowned spinning cap, four long whip-like wind arms and rocks orbiting its body.
stades.ancien: Its winds turn slow and silver-grey, carrying ancient ruins fragments in orbit, with a long trailing mist beard.

fiche: Un pachyderme de roche en fusion dont chaque pas laisse une coulée de lave dans les plaines volcaniques.
apparence: Heavy mammoth-like quadruped with cooled basalt armor over flowing lava; colors: basalt black, lava orange, molten yellow.

stades.bebe: A round black basalt calf with glowing orange cracks, big eyes and a tiny trunk.
stades.enfant: Its trunk lengthens and two small glowing tusks appear, with magma dripping from its feet.
stades.ado: Basalt armor plates form on its back and a small smoking vent opens between its shoulders.
stades.adulte: A colossal lava mammoth with huge curved molten tusks, thick basalt armor and two volcanic chimneys erupting on its back.
stades.ancien: Its armor is grey and deeply fissured, its tusks are cracked obsidian, and long strands of cooled lava hang like a beard.

fiche: Un grand dragon des marées qui dort au fond des abysses et soulève les vagues géantes en se réveillant.
apparence: Long sea-dragon body of living water with pearl scales and fin crests; colors: deep ocean blue, pearl white, turquoise.

stades.bebe: A round water bubble with a tiny curled tail inside, big eyes and two little fin ears.
stades.enfant: It stretches into a small eel shape with pearl scales and a short fin along its back.
stades.ado: The body lengthens, two small front flippers and branching coral horns appear.
stades.adulte: A colossal coiling water dragon with a crest shaped like a breaking wave, coral horns and a whirlpool at its tail.
stades.ancien: Its scales are covered in barnacles and pearls, its horns are old twisted coral, and long foam whiskers trail from its snout.

fiche: Le seigneur des éléments, un titan de roche vivante dont le corps porte une montagne et les six forces de la nature.
apparence: Colossal stone titan with a mountain on its back and six glowing elemental gems embedded in its body; colors: granite grey, crystal gold, multicolor elemental glow.

stades.bebe: A round boulder with big glowing eyes and one tiny shining gem on its forehead.
stades.enfant: Stubby rock arms and legs appear and two more gems, red and blue, glow on its chest.
stades.ado: It grows tall with rock plate shoulders, a small peak forming on its back and six colored gems on its body.
stades.adulte: A colossal granite titan carrying a snowy mountain peak on its back, with lava veins, ice shoulders, lightning-crackling fists and wind swirling around its crown.
stades.ancien: Its granite is covered in forests and ancient ruins, a waterfall flows like a beard from its jaw and a halo of six elemental lights orbits its head.
